summary: Candidate claims for a later engine epoch (math-p0039). Run every command from this handoff directory. Each is Python-only and designed to finish in under 300 s; the set sums to about 800 s. Premises (imported, not proved here): Kantor 1987 (uses CFSG); the Thas-Zagier reduction to D = mu_(n+1) in F_p with p = n^2+n+1 prime, with PG(2,2) and PG(2,8) the only special planes that are Desarguesian; Feit 1990 valid conditions 8 | n and d^(n+1) = 1 (mod p) for divisors d of n, hence n = 8 (mod 24). Thas-Zagier's n < 2*10^11 computation is NOT used. The all-orders conjecture remains open.

claims.statement: Every n = 8 (mod 24) with 8 <= n < 2*10^11 (994 blocks, 8,333,333,333 members) received an exact recomputed decision: for 7,195,675,490 members a factor 1 < q <= 10^6 with q | n^2+n+1, verified member by member; for the other 1,137,657,843 members the complete residue 2^(n+1) mod p, computed by both CPython and libmpdec. The only residue-1 members without such a factor are n = 8 (the classical plane PG(2,8)) and n = 512, eliminated by the re-derived collision 89785-1 = 89788-4 inside mu_513 mod 262657. n = 134217728 = 2^27 is eliminated by 2593 | p. Thus no non-Desarguesian flag-transitive plane has order 8 < n < 2*10^11 under the premises, without Thas-Zagier's computation.
claims.control_command: python3 code/certify.py replay --task low --blocks 0 --inject stored-digest --logs inputs/logs

claims.statement: Every n = 8 (mod 24) in [251539607552, 2*10^12) (main blocks 256..8940) received the same exact recomputed decision (factor verified per member, or complete CPython residue != 1, every 32nd residue also by libmpdec), and every one of the 8,685 block digests equals both preserved C digests. No survivor occurs.
claims.control_command: python3 code/certify.py replay --task main --blocks 256 --inject wrong-residue-unsampled --logs inputs/logs

claims.statement: Every n = 8 (mod 24) in [2*10^12, 2582236504064) (extension blocks 0..2891) received the same exact recomputed decision, and every one of the 2,892 block digests equals both preserved C digests. No survivor occurs.
claims.control_command: python3 code/certify.py replay --task extension --blocks 0 --inject stored-digest --logs inputs/logs

claims.statement: Under the premises, no non-Desarguesian flag-transitive projective plane has order n < 2582236504064. The four segments are contiguous: [8, 2*10^11) and [251539607552, 2582236504064) were replayed here, and [2*10^11, 251539607552) is the attack-e2 exact Python replay, checked here only as archived records with pinned hashes. Partial result; the all-orders conjecture is open.

For a >= 3 and P = 4^a+2^a+1 (prime or not), the 3a residues 2^i mod P form a Sidon set (proofs/FORCED-SUBGROUP.md, Theorem 3, elementary Eisenstein-integer proof). Hence, for n = 2^a with P prime, no certificate consisting of repeated nonzero differences inside the forced subgroup <2> (which contains 2, all divisors of n and mu_3) can exclude n; further exclusions need additional information. No novelty asserted; it also follows from Singer's construction with a trace theorem.

p_10 = 2^118098 + 2^59049 + 1 (n = 2^59049, a = 3^10) is composite: 3^(p-1) mod p != 1 (low 64 bits 4674363860819735172, residue SHA-256 c1921cf0353f39be3aea7b49ebd85d9366636276ffdfe9ac070ed9ae88e3af39), computed by staged CPython arithmetic and independently by GNU MP mpz_powm. Under the premises (p must be prime; p prime forces a = 3^t; attack-e2 settled t = 2..9), every power-of-two order 2^a with 3 < a < 177147 is excluded. Base 2 is a Fermat liar for every member of this family.

All positive and discriminating negative controls pass: injected q = p, wrong and false factors, wrong sampled and unsampled residues, a residue equal to 1, corrupted expected or stored digests, and ten receipt mutations (gap simulated by omission, conflicting duplicate, shifted geometry, foreign checker hash, inserted or unresolved survivor, broken collision witness, bookkeeping, C-digest mismatch, libmpdec count), each rejected with the expected explicit reason; the unmutated reduced fixture passes as a baseline. Fixtures are written under controls/fixtures/<run-id>/ and kept; nothing is deleted.
claims.control_command: python3 code/certify.py run --task tiny --first 0 --last 0 --inject q-equals-p --logs inputs/logs

claims.statement: Two validation-only fixes (2026-10-16) close the malformed-receipt defects found by the independent certificate-code audit (aliased or zero-difference collision pairs, fractional factor witnesses, replay with a non-positive libmpdec stride) and by its focused re-review (replay accepted id false, start 8.0 and a witness coordinate true because it lacked type checks and compared with Python equality). Replay and coverage now share one strict rule set (code/receipt_checks.py) and replay compares in type-exact canonical JSON. For nine malformed fixtures the archived earlier code accepts the input and the current code rejects it with an explicit reason; a bit-flipped copy of the archived producer is rejected; authentic receipts still pass coverage through 2582236504064 and replay exactly. Arithmetic paths are unchanged and all 446 receipts keep their original producer stamp f6eaa1a8.

next_step: Exact exclusion of a single larger power-of-two candidate (p_10 = Phi_(3^11)(2)) or a uniform argument; extending the scan further adds orders but cannot settle the conjecture.
